title: SOC2 evidence scratchpad - daily TODOs
content:
Morning scratchpad - quick capture of what I need to do / follow up on for SOC2 evidence. Rough, incomplete, mostly reminders to self.

Top priorities for today:
1) KMS: confirm cross-account access logs are in S3 lifecycle 90d (evidence). Ticket JIRA-SEC-412 assigned to Priya. Action: ping Priya at 10:30am if no update. Note: need export of CloudTrail events filtered for kms:Decrypt/kms:GenerateDataKey - timeframe: 2025-12-01 -> 2026-03-05.
2) Vendor attestation: AcmeVault (key mgmt vendor) - verify they provided SOC2 Type II report. Email thread in #vendor-security and Confluence doc. Action: follow up w/ vendor contact Linda <linda@acmevault.com> for signed attestation and date range (prefer full 2025 coverage). If not available, escalate to Sam for interim compensating control.
3) Access reviews: scheduled weekly for platform infra accounts. Need evidence export (list of IAM changes) for Feb 2026. Shortcut: use internal script ./tools/iam-audit -> output in /tmp/iam-feb-2026.csv. Save to evidence bucket evidence/redwood/soc2/access-reviews/feb-2026.csv and attach to CONFLUENCE-Redwood-SOC2-Access-Reviews page.
4) Policy TODOs: update Data Retention policy to include logs retention defaults (90d for CloudTrail, 180d for app logs unless flagged). Draft text below for review: "All system-level audit logs (CloudTrail, KMS, VPC flow logs) are retained for a minimum of 90 days. Application-level logs are retained for 180 days by default unless flagged for longer retention per product team request and approved by Security." Put on agenda for Thurs policy sync.

Quick notes / fragments:
- Evidence pack checklist: signed vendor reports, exported ACLs/IAM lists, configuration snapshots (S3 bucket policies), CloudTrail export, KMS key policy snapshots, change logs for infra (Terraform state snapshots), access review CSVs, meeting minutes for approvals.
- Vendor review matrix: AcmeVault (KMS) - pending attestation; Loglify (logging infra) - has SOC2 but expired Aug 2025 -> need renewal proof; AuthFlow (SSO) - OK. Update spreadsheet today -> JIRA-SEC-398 owner: Sam.
- Short term compensating control if vendor attestation missing: require monthly signed SOC2 in escrow or configure additional monitoring (CloudWatch alarm for unusual key usage) + documented exception in Confluence.
- Slack refs: #security-ops, #vendor-security, message link placeholder.

Meeting notes (yesterday) - follow ups:
- With Priya: agreed to scope of KMS evidence exports and who runs the script (Priya will run; I will verify).
- With Legal: they want copies of vendor contracts for any vendor without current attestations. Action: Sam to pull contract PDFs and drop them in secured drive link.

Personal TODO (today):
- [ ] 10:30am ping Priya re: KMS export
- [ ] 11:00am short call w/ Linda (AcmeVault) if no attestation in inbox
- [ ] export IAM changes for Feb 2026 and save CSV to evidence bucket
- [ ] update vendor spreadsheet w/ current statuses + flags
- [ ] draft retention policy update and add to Thurs agenda
- [ ] add findings to CONFLUENCE-Redwood-SOC2-Controls page as comments

Notes to self: keep entries terse. capture ticket numbers and file locations. evidence artifacts need clear filenames: e.g., kms-cloudtrail-2025-12-01_2026-03-05.json, iam-changes-feb-2026.csv. When in doubt, upload to evidence/redwood/soc2/pending and link from confluence page.

Open questions / blockers:
- Do we accept vendor reports with gap (partial coverage) if compensating controls documented? (legal wants full coverage but pragmatic ops needs temporary path) -> raise in weekly sec sync.
- Who owns retention policy approval? Product or SecOps? Need a named approver for sign-off.

End scratchpad. Will tidy into proper evidence checklist doc after attachments are collected.

-- maya
